biography.value:
Many oculorbs are dreamed into existence by @UUID[Actor.pbsoBeholder0000]{beholders}. The Far Realm’s strange power can pervade a beholder’s dreams, resulting in the birth of an oculorb.

Oculorbs resemble a slimy conglomeration of eyes in many sizes and shapes. They are dreaded even by the beholders that birth them. An oculorb is a tangle of negative emotions—the fury, melancholy, and obsession of its creator, all given gruesome, corporeal form. Like a beholder, an oculorb can fire beams of energy from its eyes, but an oculorb’s eyes lack the more sophisticated magical nature of a beholder’s eyestalks. Instead, an oculorb unleashes powerful waves of energy charged with negative emotions, cowing its foes with despair and ire.

description.value: The oculorb has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
The oculorb makes two [[/item Dreadful Contact]] attacks or four [[/item Eye Beam]] attacks.
The oculorb has advantage on initiative rolls and can’t be &Reference[surprise]{surprised}.

Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic damage, or [[/damage 6d6 + @abilities.cha.mod average type=psychic]] damage if the target has the &Reference[frightened]{frightened} condition.

The oculorb makes dreadful contact.

Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic damage.

The oculorb fires an eye beam.
The oculorb releases a wave of negative emotions, choosing one of the following options: @UUID[.6YFSyrWx0GP6vLR6]{Weeping Eyes} or @UUID[.veLjObZ9BfrcGgeZ]{Withering Glare}

The oculorb weeps, releasing a wave of crushing despair. Each creature within 30 feet of the oculorb must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature’s speed is reduced to 0 feet until the end of the oculorb’s next turn, and if the creature was concentrating, its concentration is broken.

The oculorb’s eyes unleash furious scarlet energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 33 (6d10) necrotic damage and has the &Reference[frightened] condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a successful save.

effects.name: Withered
effects.description: The target has the &Reference[Frightened] condition for 1 minute.

description.value: When the oculorb is damaged by a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself, it forces the creature to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. The creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

activation.condition: When the oculorb is damaged by a creature it can see within 60 feet
